answers.goal: I’m a creative technologist & immersive filmmaker. My goal is to pioneer novel AI-accelerated pipelines across various creative verticals - virtual production, CG animation, location-based entertainment, and beyond. Additionally, I’m developing the next generation of immersive theatrical presentation that pushes the envelope beyond IMAX, VR, dome, etc.
answers.drew: Watching Toy Story 3 for the first time in theatres and being absolutely immersed. That and the unique space on film that combines tech with creative innovation.
answers.seeking: Fearless creatives open to technological innovation while also being deeply grounded artists + critical thinkers.
answers.inspiration: Seiji Ozawa, Akira Kurosawa, Jim Cameron, Steve Jobs, to name a few.
